title: Pane queue keeps an entry whose card file briefly fails to parse
notes: Left open by #408's review. pane-pool.ts:123 drops a queued entry as 'not on the board' when its card file fails to parse for a moment (for example mid-write during a board sync), so a queued ship silently vanishes. Fix only in the drain's readiness read: an unreadable card holds the entry, it does not drop it; queueRefusal and withdrawnColumn keep their board. The final check reverted a broader attempt (4485d81e) for nulling the board there too.

comments.body: Pull request #410 opened: Hold a queued ship while its card file does not parse https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/410

Review loop: converged, ready to merge. 1 round, 2 low findings fixed (7645bce1, 8cd6118a): withdraw test now uses a move that refuses while a card file is broken, as the real one does; the parse-failure wait now applies only to entries with a card, so a cardless ship still gets its 'no card was queued' refusal. Nothing rejected or open, no conflicts, CI green on the head commit. The PR description's 'a withdrawal still puts the card back' does not hold while a card file is broken.
Pull request #410 merged: Hold a queued ship while its card file does not parse https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/410
